artworks.title: Death of Actaeon Reported to Autonoe and Aristaeus
artworks.description: Louvre krater CA 3482: while Artemis drives deer and Actaeon dies, a messenger reports to his parents — Autonoe and Aristaeus named in the scene. Cadmus' daughter as grieving mother, not only as Bacchant.

artworks.title: Death of Actaeon (Louvre krater, full)
artworks.description: Full view of the same Louvre crater: Actaeon's doom and the parental pair — Autonoe among the Cadmean women whose house Artemis and Dionysus both shatter.

artworks.title: Torment of Pentheus (House of the Vettii)
artworks.description: Pompeii fresco of Pentheus torn by maenads — Autonoe among the Cadmean sisters Euripides drives mad with Agave on Cithaeron.

artworks.title: Actaeon Torn by Dogs (terracotta lamp)
artworks.description: Roman lamp of Actaeon's death — Autonoe's son destroyed by his own hounds, the Cadmean mother's grief cast in clay for everyday light.

popCulture.title: The Bacchae
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides drives Autonoe with Agave and Ino into the mountain madness that tears Pentheus — Cadmus' daughter as Bacchant aunt of the king.

popCulture.title: Actaeon
popCulture.description: Autonoe's hunter son — Artemis' victim whose death vase-painters report back to his mother.
